outcome: Lumbar puncture (LP) performance in LOS evaluations
cohort: The study participants were 13,372 infants born extremely preterm (22 to 26 weeks' gestation) at 25 Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health and Human Development Neonatal Research Network centers.
finding: Late-onset meningitis (LOM) incidence decreased over time, and both LOM and late-onset sepsis (LOS) were associated with an increased risk of death or neurodevelopmental impairment, with risk varying by LOM pathogen.
